limit.setup: one completed building from an explicitly played Core-valid project with material-flow lineage; 6 timber after consumption; allowance 2; proposed distinct-project contract available
assertions: A reserves the last place and 3 available timber without transferring or consuming it
B is rejected; no additional stock, place or material commitment, or elapsed work change

concurrency.setup: one completed building from an explicitly played Core-valid project with material-flow lineage; 6 timber after consumption; allowance 2; proposed distinct-project contract available; two same-revision attempts
assertions: at most one distinct project is immediately admitted; both may be deferred
if both are deferred, neither obtains a place or material reservation and stock is unchanged
if one is admitted, exactly one place and at most 3 unconsumed timber are reserved; stock is unchanged
any later authorized resolution or retry must revalidate state; no winner or priority is presumed

pause-complete.setup: one completed building from an explicitly played Core-valid project with material-flow lineage; 6 timber after consumption; allowance 2; proposed distinct-project contract available
assertions: active work reserves 3 timber without stock debit
pause retains the building place and releases the material reservation without stock credit
resume rechecks material and authority; completion consumes 3 timber once and converts the place reservation into one lineage-linked building

cancel.setup: one completed building from an explicitly played Core-valid project with material-flow lineage; 6 timber after consumption; allowance 2; proposed distinct-project contract available
assertions: before-work cancellation releases the building place and the material reservation without crediting stock
a repeated cancellation cannot credit stock or release another place
replacement may reserve the freed place after revalidation

refusal.setup: a legitimately recorded fictional council and site; unfavorable site review; allowance 2; proposed authority contract available
assertions: record refusal; allowance stays 2
request and refusal change no stock, commitments or elapsed work

valid-expansion.setup: a legitimately recorded fictional council and site; one favorable unused site review; usage 2; allowance 2; proposed authority contract available
assertions: an offered term leaves allowance at 2
separate accepted, valid offer raises allowance to 3 once and consumes review eligibility
next feasible building may reserve the new place

invalid-issuer.setup: claimant lacks jurisdiction for this site; allowance 2; proposed authority contract available
assertions: no valid offer or grant; allowance unchanged
no invented authority, stock transfer, time or commitment

recovery.setup: valid favorable unused review and issuer; initial allowance 2; proposed authority contract available
assertions: accepted expansion raises allowance to 3 once
same request returns original actor-scoped receipt after reload without another increase or consumption
restore behavior is fenced according to the future reviewed Engine contract

retained-works.setup: one completed building from an explicitly played Core-valid project with material-flow lineage; 6 timber after consumption; allowance 2; proposed distinct-project contract available
assertions: after-work cancellation retains physical works and occupied place under this proposal
release of unconsumed material reservation is not a stock credit; consumed timber is never credited twice
a new building is not admitted into the occupied place without a separately reviewed disposition

review-reuse.setup: one expansion was accepted, and its favorable review eligibility consumed; same site and issuer
assertions: the consumed review cannot authorize another offer or grant
a newly recorded favorable review is required for further proposed consideration
no second increase occurs from a retry or duplicate acceptance

limitations: Proposed expectations only; no Core execution, NPC behavior, permission, save migration or campaign availability is verified.
Setup values, refusal cause and site review are evaluator truth; they are not supplied as actor instructions.
No immediate winner, priority, expiry duration, migration or post-work disposition is selected.
